The Rules Advocate described the suspended/canceled substitution in Thrawn and General Leia Organa’s Admiral’s Orders text as a wording clarification without a gameplay difference.<ref>Rules Advocate announcement, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1384402#p1384402 official post]. Posted 2 August 2022 at 04:57:04 UTC; the statement concerns the suspended/canceled wording for the two named cards’ Admiral’s Orders text.</ref>
The official release article is dated 9 August 2022 and reports that the six errata were included in the PDF publicly released that day. Its exact linked PDF is the combined Set 19 and errata source, whose Thrawn partial matches the standalone August errata in native RGB and original mask. The separately mentioned 15 August date is for GEMP, not the PDF release.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/the-beautiful-and-thematic-virtual-set-19-has-arrived/ Official Players Committee release article], 9 August 2022; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-19-Plus-Errata.pdf linked combined PDF], page 7. The actual live article date, body and PDF link were verified in a browser. The current PDF’s Thrawn RGB and mask match the standalone August edition; no independently preserved 2022 article or PDF bytes were verified.</ref>
